    Evaluating the covariant defect #

    Evaluation is exact on the finite linear functor category. Consequently the value of the covariant defect at X is the ordinary quotient

    Hom(A, X) / im(Hom(B, X) → Hom(A, X))

    attached to the first map A → B of the module complex.
